normative_semantic_rule: All successful write operations that change the RenderJob's externally observable persistent business state must update updated_at. This rule applies to all current and future methods that perform such state changes.
normative_update_type_rule: All updated_at writes must use java.time.Instant. The application must not use OffsetDateTime, LocalDateTime, or any other temporal type for persistence writes to this column.

methods_not_writing_updated_at.note: This method does NOT write updated_at. If it is used for legitimate business state changes, it should be updated to include updated_at per the normative semantic rule. Current contract does not mandate immediate fix.

future_method_requirements: Any new Repository method that changes RenderJob external business state must include SET updated_at = Instant.now() in its UPDATE statement. The current method list is NOT a permanent closed list — it is an inventory snapshot as of the normalization date.
missing_update_detection: Omission of updated_at write in a state-changing method can be detected by: (1) code review against the normative semantic rule, (2) comparing the set of UPDATE methods that change status with the set that write updated_at, (3) integration tests that verify updated_at changes on state transitions.
test_requirements_for_new_write_paths: Any new method that writes updated_at must include a test verifying the column is updated after the state transition. Any existing method that is retrofitted to write updated_at must similarly have its test updated.
